🇬🇧 English

🇨🇳 简体中文

* 可在应用内登录 HME 账户并管理您的设备。
* 改进了模拟器痕迹隐藏。
* 稳定性提升。
* 更新后请重启设备。

🇷🇺 Русский
* Новые способы оплаты: Premium можно купить прямо в приложении через PayPal или криптовалютой / банковским переводом, Google Play по-прежнему доступен.
* Вход в аккаунт HME и управление устройствами прямо в приложении.
* Улучшено скрытие следов эмулятора.
* Повышена стабильность.
* После обновления перезагрузите устройство.

🇮🇩 Bahasa Indonesia
* Metode pembayaran baru: beli Premium langsung di aplikasi dengan PayPal atau Kripto / Transfer bank, Google Play tetap tersedia.
* Login ke akun HME dan kelola perangkat Anda langsung di aplikasi.
* Penyembunyian jejak emulator yang lebih baik.
* Peningkatan stabilitas.
* Harap mulai ulang perangkat setelah memperbarui.

🇮🇳 Hindi (Latin)
* Naye payment methods: ab Premium seedhe app mein PayPal ya Crypto / Bank transfer se khareedein, Google Play bhi pehle ki tarah uplabdh hai.
* App mein hi apne HME account se sign in karein aur apne devices manage karein.
* Emulator traces ko chhupana aur behtar kiya gaya.
* Stability mein sudhaar.
* Update ke baad kripya apne device ko restart karein.

<!-- hme-min-version-code: 5 -->

What's new in 1.3

- New Support tab: chat with our team right inside the app. Send a message or a screenshot, and we reply as soon as possible. If you have Premium, your account is recognised automatically, so you never have to explain your setup again.
- Improved UI/UX: a clearer Status screen that shows what Premium unlocks, plus a 3-day trial you can start in one tap.
- Small fixes and polish.
- You will be asked to update if you are on an older version, so everyone gets the new Support tab and the latest protection.

Requirements: Android 9.0+ (API 28), a rooted emulator (Magisk or any other root method) and a working LSPosed environment. Tested on the Android Studio emulator (Android 16, arm64) and on LDPlayer (Android 9, x86_64).

Protection works with an active Premium subscription, managed by the [HME License](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.wowsoftware.hmelicense) app on Google Play. Install it, subscribe, and Hide My Emulator picks up Premium automatically.

Install guide: https://hidemyemulator.com/en/how-to-install/
Support: in-app Support tab · https://t.me/wowareofficial · wowareofficial@gmail.com

<!-- hme-min-version-code: 4 -->

What's new in 1.2

- Improved anti-detection: some apps refuse to open when they think a tool is watching or tampering with them. Hide My Emulator now hides that sign, so those apps open and run normally.
- Improved the "Hide root" and "Hide Xposed & hooking" protection: closed a loophole some apps used to peek behind the disguise, so however an app checks, your emulator, root and this module stay hidden.
- You will be asked to update if you are on an older version, so everyone gets the latest protection.

Requirements: Android 9.0+ (API 28), a rooted emulator (Magisk or any other root method) and a working LSPosed environment. Tested on the Android Studio emulator (Android 16, arm64) and on LDPlayer (Android 9, x86_64).

Protection works with an active Premium subscription, managed by the [HME License](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.wowsoftware.hmelicense) app on Google Play. Install it, subscribe, and Hide My Emulator picks up Premium automatically.

Install guide: https://hidemyemulator.com/en/how-to-install/
Support: https://t.me/wowareofficial · wowareofficial@gmail.com

<!-- hme-min-version-code: 3 -->

- Hide root: Magisk, su and root-manager apps are now hidden from the apps you protect, so root checks come back clean.
- Hide Xposed / LSPosed: this module and the LSPosed framework are now hidden, so apps that check for them come back clean.
- Protect any app you pick in the LSPosed scope, not a fixed list. The Android system is never touched.
- New "Hide root" and "Hide Xposed & hooking" switches in the Status tab, on or off with one tap.
- Stability fixes on Android 16.

First release of Hide My Emulator on the Xposed Modules Repo.

- Makes the apps you pick see a real phone instead of an emulator. Phone name and model, sensors, battery, touchscreen and keys, phone radio, camera, location, graphics, processor, and emulator-only settings and files all describe one real phone.
- Only the apps you tick in the LSPosed scope are touched. Their data, accounts and files stay as they are. The module stays out of the Android system framework.
- Turn each protection on or off with one tap in the Status tab, then tap Apply. Changes take effect the next time a protected app starts.
- Works on ARM and x86 emulators. Tested on the Android Studio emulator and on LDPlayer (Android 9, x86_64).
- Checks this page for new versions and offers the update inside the app, from the Status tab or App info.
- App UI in English, Chinese (Simplified), Russian, Indonesian and Hindi.

Package name: `net.wowsoftware.hidemyemulator`. If you installed an earlier build under another package name, uninstall it first; this release does not update it.

Requirements: Android 9.0+ (API 28), a rooted emulator (Magisk or any other root method) and a working LSPosed environment.

Protection works with an active Premium subscription, managed by the [HME License](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.wowsoftware.hmelicense) app on Google Play. Install it, subscribe, and Hide My Emulator picks up Premium automatically.

Install guide: https://hidemyemulator.com/en/how-to-install/

# Hide My Emulator

![Hide My Emulator](images/thumbnail.png)

[![Download](https://img.shields.io/badge/Download-2D333B?style=for-the-badge&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/net.wowsoftware.hidemyemulator/releases/latest) [![Latest Release](https://img.shields.io/badge/Latest%20Release-2F81F7?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/net.wowsoftware.hidemyemulator/releases/latest)

An LSPosed module that hides your emulator, so apps think they run on a real phone.

Apps can tell when they run in an emulator. Hide My Emulator makes them see a real phone instead.

## Support / Discussion

Support: https://t.me/hidemyemulator  
Official Website: https://hidemyemulator.com  
How to install: https://hidemyemulator.com/en/how-to-install/  
Email: wowareofficial@gmail.com

## Requirements

- Android 9.0+ (API level 28 or newer)
- A rooted Android emulator (Magisk or any other root method)
- A properly working LSPosed environment
- Developed and tested on the Android Studio emulator (AVD). Other emulators that can be rooted and run LSPosed follow the same steps.
- If you are not familiar with Xposed modules, this project may not be suitable for your setup.

## How It Works

Tick the apps you want to protect in the LSPosed scope. When one of them opens, Hide My Emulator changes what it sees about the device, so every detail describes one real phone. Apps you did not tick are not touched at all, and the data, accounts and files of the apps you did tick stay as they are. Masking applies the next time a ticked app starts.

## Feature List

- **Phone name and model** — Apps see a real phone brand and model, not an emulator.
- **Emulator settings and files** — Settings and files that only an emulator has are gone, just like on a real phone.
- **Sensors** — Sensors look like real phone parts, not the emulator's fake ones.
- **Battery** — Battery size, health and charging look like a real phone.
- **Touchscreen and keys** — The touchscreen and buttons carry real hardware names.
- **Phone radio** — The modem shows a normal phone version instead of nothing.
- **Camera** — Camera count and direction match a real phone.
- **Location** — A believable last location instead of an empty one.
- **Graphics** — The graphics chip shows a real phone GPU, not the emulator's.
- **Processor** — Apps see a phone processor, not the PC chip the emulator runs on.
- **Root** — Root stays out of sight, so apps that check for it see an ordinary unrooted phone.
- **LSPosed and hooking** — The LSPosed framework and its hooks stay hidden, so apps cannot tell anything is attached.
- **Everything matches** — Every detail describes the same phone, so nothing gives it away.
- **Pick your apps** — Choose which apps get the real-phone look. Turn each part on or off with one tap.

## Getting Started

1. **Prepare your emulator** — Root the emulator ([Magisk](https://github.com/topjohnwu/Magisk/releases) or any other root method) and install the [LSPosed](https://github.com/JingMatrix/LSPosed/releases) framework.
2. **Install Hide My Emulator** — Install the APK, turn the module on in LSPosed Manager and tick the apps you want.
3. **Choose what to mask** — Turn on what you want hidden in the Status tab and tap Apply. It applies the next time the app opens.
4. **Relaunch the target app** — Force-stop and reopen the app. It now sees a real phone.

Full guide with screenshots: https://hidemyemulator.com/en/how-to-install/

## Premium

Hide My Emulator is a paid module. Protection works with an active Premium subscription, managed by the [HME License](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.wowsoftware.hmelicense) app: install it from Google Play, subscribe, and Hide My Emulator picks up your Premium status automatically. Cancel any time from Google Play subscriptions.

Premium includes everything in the feature list, updates while subscribed, and email and Telegram support.

## Important Notice

System-level modification always carries risk.  
Please back up your emulator image and important data before use.

## Disclaimer

Use at your own risk.  
By installing or using Hide My Emulator, you are solely responsible for how you use it.  
The developers are not responsible for misuse, violations of laws/platform policies, account penalties, data loss, instability, or bootloops.

## Ongoing Updates

Hide My Emulator is actively maintained with continuous feature and stability updates.

## Feature Requests

Feature requests are welcome.  
If you need a specific capability, share your use case on Telegram or by email and we will prioritize based on community demand.

---

From the makers of [Hide My Android](https://www.hidemyandroid.com).

# 隐藏我的模拟器

![隐藏我的模拟器](images/thumbnail.png)

[![下载](https://img.shields.io/badge/Download-2D333B?style=for-the-badge&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/net.wowsoftware.hidemyemulator/releases/latest) [![最新发布](https://img.shields.io/badge/Latest%20Release-2F81F7?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/net.wowsoftware.hidemyemulator/releases/latest)

LSPosed 模块隐藏您的模拟器，因此应用程序认为它们在真实手机上运行。

应用程序可以判断它们何时在模拟器中运行。隐藏我的模拟器让他们看到的是真正的手机。

## 支持/讨论

支持：https://t.me/hidemyemulator  
官方网站：https://hidemyemulator.com  
如何安装：https://hidemyemulator.com/en/how-to-install/  
电子邮件：wowareofficial@gmail.com

## 要求

- Android 9.0+（API 级别 28 或更高版本）
- 已root的Android模拟器（Magisk或任何其他root方法）
- 正常工作的 LSPod 环境
- 在 Android Studio 模拟器 (AVD) 上开发和测试。其他可以获取 root 权限并运行 LSPod 的模拟器也遵循相同的步骤。
- 如果您不熟悉 Xposed 模块，该项目可能不适合您的设置。

## 它是如何工作的

在 LSPod 范围中勾选您想要保护的应用程序。当其中一个打开时，“隐藏我的模拟器”会更改它所看到的有关设备的内容，因此每个细节都描述了一部真实的手机。您未勾选的应用程序根本不会受到影响，您勾选的应用程序的数据、帐户和文件将保持原样。勾选的应用程序下次启动时将应用屏蔽。

## 功能列表

- **手机名称和型号** — 应用程序看到的是真实的手机品牌和型号，而不是模拟器。
- **模拟器设置和文件** — 只有模拟器才有的设置和文件消失了，就像在真实手机上一样。
- **传感器** — 传感器看起来像真正的手机部件，而不是模拟器的假部件。
- **电池** — 电池尺寸、运行状况和充电看起来像真正的手机。
- **触摸屏和按键** — 触摸屏和按钮带有真实的硬件名称。
- **电话收音机** — 调制解调器显示正常的电话版本，而不是不显示任何内容。
- **相机** — 相机数量和方向与真实手机相符。
- **位置** — 一个可信的最后一个位置，而不是一个空的位置。
- **图形** — 图形芯片显示真实的手机 GPU，而不是模拟器的 GPU。
- **处理器** — 应用程序看到的是手机处理器，而不是模拟器运行的 PC 芯片。
- **Root** — Root 处于看不见的状态，因此检查它的应用程序会看到普通的未 root 手机。
- **LSPosed 和挂钩** — LSPosed 框架及其挂钩保持隐藏状态，因此应用程序无法识别附加的任何内容。
- **一切都匹配** — 每个细节都描述了同一部手机，所以没有任何东西会泄露它。
- **选择您的应用程序** — 选择哪些应用程序具有真实手机外观。只需轻轻一按即可打开或关闭每个部分。

## 开始使用

1. **准备模拟器** — Root 模拟器（[Magisk](https://github.com/topjohnwu/Magisk/releases) 或任何其他 Root 方法）并安装 [LSPosed](https://github.com/JingMatrix/LSPosed/releases) 框架。
2. **安装隐藏我的模拟器** — 安装 APK，在 LSPod Manager 中打开模块并勾选您想要的应用程序。
3. **选择要屏蔽的内容** — 在状态选项卡中打开您想要隐藏的内容，然后点击应用。它会在下次打开应用程序时应用。
4. **重新启动目标应用程序** — 强制停止并重新打开应用程序。现在它看到了一部真正的手机。

带屏幕截图的完整指南：https://hidemyemulator.com/en/how-to-install/

## 高级版

隐藏我的模拟器是一个付费模块。保护功能适用于有效的高级订阅，由 [HME 许可证](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.wowsoftware.hmelicense) 应用程序管理：从 Google Play 安装并订阅，隐藏我的模拟器会自动获取您的高级状态。随时取消 Google Play 订阅。

高级版包括功能列表中的所有内容、订阅时的更新以及电子邮件和电报支持。

## 重要通知

系统级修改阳离子总是带有风险。  
使用前请备份您的模拟器镜像和重要数据。

## 免责声明

使用风险自负。  
通过安装或使用“隐藏我的模拟器”，您应对其使用方式承担全部责任。  
开发人员不对滥用、违反法律/平台政策、帐户处罚、数据丢失、不稳定或引导循环负责。

## 持续更新

隐藏我的模拟器得到积极维护，并不断更新功能和稳定性。

## 功能请求

欢迎提出功能请求。  
如果您需要特定功能，请在 Telegram 或通过电子邮件分享您的用例，我们将根据社区需求确定优先级。
